Finished the Stalingrad strategy game in `index.html`. Both factions are playable, with squad movement, ranged combat, terrain cover, strategic objectives, an enemy turn, victory scoring, and a restart flow.

I also refined the tactical briefing and enemy movement. Verified the game in Chromium and smoke-tested unit selection, movement, the enemy response, and turn advancement.

Assumption: the existing single-file game was the intended project, so I completed and tested it rather than replacing it.
